title: Obtaining calibrated probability estimates from ensemble classifiers
methodology: CalibratedClassifierCV with Platt scaling and isotonic regression
finding: Gradient boosting systematically miscalibrates; calibration essential for probabilistic predictions
limitation: Requires sufficient calibration data; isotonic overfits on small samples
implementation_decision: Adopted sigmoid as default, isotonic as option

title: A New Interpretation of Information Rate
methodology: Kelly criterion for optimal bet sizing
finding: Maximises long-run growth rate but has significant short-term variance
limitation: Requires exact probability knowledge; estimation error causes ruin

title: Stacked Generalization
finding: Stacking reduces generalization error by learning optimal blend weights
limitation: Meta-learner can overfit if base models are correlated
implementation_decision: Implemented stacking ensemble with logistic regression meta-learner

title: An Introduction to the Bootstrap
methodology: Resample with replacement to estimate sampling distributions
finding: Distribution-free CI estimation; 5000 resamples gives stable estimates
limitation: Assumes exchangeability; block bootstrap needed for time series
implementation_decision: Bootstrap CI for ROI, Sharpe, all key metrics

title: Algorithmic Learning in a Random World
methodology: Conformal prediction for distribution-free prediction sets
finding: Finite-sample coverage guarantees without distributional assumptions
limitation: Prediction sets can be wide; adaptive methods needed for shift
implementation_decision: Implemented conformal prediction for uncertainty estimation

title: LightGBM: A Highly Efficient Gradient Boosting Decision Tree
finding: 3x faster than standard GBM with comparable or better accuracy
limitation: Can overfit on very small datasets
implementation_decision: Added LightGBM as ML layer option

title: The Deflated Sharpe Ratio
methodology: Correct Sharpe ratio for multiple testing bias
finding: Probability of selecting an overfit strategy grows rapidly with number of tests
limitation: Requires knowing the number of strategies tested
implementation_decision: Used in iterative controller for honest comparison

title: Advances in Financial Machine Learning
methodology: Purged K-Fold CV, embargo periods, fractional differentiation
finding: Backtest overfitting is the #1 reason ML strategies fail in production
limitation: Complex implementation; requires careful window selection
implementation_decision: Strict chronological split with no overlap

title: Smart football match prediction
methodology: Multi-metric evaluation for sports prediction models
finding: Calibration error directly impacts betting ROI more than accuracy
implementation_decision: Multi-metric evaluation framework (ECE, Brier, log-loss, ROI)

title: Closing Line Value as a measure of betting skill
methodology: CLV analysis across professional and recreational bettors
finding: CLV is the strongest predictor of long-term profitability
implementation_decision: CLV t-stat and CLV win rate as first-class metrics
